Title: Relates to an occupancy tax for the town of Orchard Park
Summary: Authorizes the town of Orchard Park, county of Erie, to impose a hotel and motel occupancy tax not to exceed four percent.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the tax law, in relation to authorizing the town of Orchard Park to establish hotel and motel taxes; and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
